text:
violet_ops: Quick PM follow-up: we keep getting short-lived paging storms for the inference edge (lots of 403 bursts). Postmortem listed remediation items but we need owners, ETAs, and a clear rollout plan so runbooks + paging policies can be updated. Tracker: https://go/rems/inference-edge-churn.

harry_oncall: I'll own short-term triage + dedupe logic. Proposal: dedupe key = client_id|route|hash(payload,6) and a per-key suppression window of 2m. That should stop repeated pages from the same retry loop. Will prototype in staging.

mina_sre: I'll take thresholds/aggregation and the monthly churn audit job. Plan: bump client-scoped alert threshold by +10% initially, monitor 7d, then +25% if safe. Also add a global p99 spike detector to avoid masking real regressions.

oliver_dev: I'll implement a small hashing util and a deterministic hash function for the paging system. Suggest including truncated body + route + first header value (if present) to reduce false merges. ETA 4d.

remed-bot: Incident 2028-01-07: inference-edge 403 spike -> 36 pages, peak 03:22 UTC.

jo_prod: Recommend a gated rollout: staging -> canary 5% prod (48h) -> gradual. Also will coordinate outreach for the top noisy clients so they can patch retry behavior.

harry_oncall: Draft alert (staging) for review:
```
alert: InferenceEdgeAuthBurst
expr: sum(rate(edge_responses_total{code="403"}[5m])) by (client_id, route) > 45
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: "/runbooks/inference-edge-403.md"
```
Paging dedupe config (paging service): key: "{{client_id}}:{{route}}:{{hash(payload,6)}}" suppression_window: 120s

mina_sre: Looks good. Can we add a synthetic that replays the retry loop pattern so the canary validates suppression doesn't swallow legitimate spikes? I can sketch dashboard panels (unique dedupe keys, pages/day, percent suppressed).

oliver_dev: I will add the synthetic harness to CI and wire a small traffic replay job. Tagging PR with pm-followup/alert-tuning.

harry_oncall: Owners + ETAs (rough): harry (dedupe+suppress) 10d, mina (thresholds+audit) 18d, oliver (hash util+synthetic) 5d, jo (client coordination) 12d. I'll open GH issues and add tags.

jo_prod: Adding client outreach list to the tracker. Will follow up with product notes for customers who may be impacted.

mina_sre: For rollout, recommend 48h canary and then compare pages/day and unique dedupe keys. If pages drop >60% and no increase in global p99, we mark short-term done. I'll own the verification dashboard.

harry_oncall: PR draft for paging config changes is up, tests included. Marked WIP.

oliver_dev: Hash util PR opened, includes unit tests and a small integration test against staging paging.

violet_ops: Great. Sync Friday 10:00 UTC to review PR links and dashboard baselines. Please add the GH issue IDs to the remediation tracker and set the milestone "alert-tuning/Q1". If anyone hits infra limits for canaries ping me.

harry_oncall: ack. :white_check_mark:
